title: NO CARD WHEN YOU LOOT A GUN
why: His order 10-20: weapon card popups when weapons are looted are invasive and not helpful. Looting a gun no longer raises its stat card. The pickup row stays; the card stays in the backpack, on the belt hover and in the forge.
now: Picking up a gun shows no stat card. Check a gun by opening the backpack or hovering its slot.
